An email password reset may restore account access but not decrypt data without a surviving trusted device or recovery secret. A server administrator must not secretly possess an escrow key while the UI claims otherwise. No automatic destructive account recreation on recovery failure, and no support workflow asking users to paste their secrets into chat.

Invalid credentials or corrupted input must preserve current data. Plain exports, where intentionally supported, need explicit disclosure that the contents are readable and private; do not make public logs or support uploads of them automatic.

Retries after network loss must not duplicate a meal, Habit completion, contribution, reversal or financial operation. Reopening the app resumes bounded pending work safely.

requirements.title: Financial operations require invariant-preserving concurrency

On conflict, refresh, revalidate and explicitly resolve rather than silently applying an invalid allocation or dropping one device's action. Offline financial changes may remain provisional until reconciled; make this visible.

Concurrent corrections to one original record need a deterministic bounded rule or explicit conflict state, not two independently successful full reversals.
